title: Northgate Credit Cards Rewards Program Terms: Earning
content:
These terms govern how rewards are earned on every Northgate Credit Cards account. The rates, the gas and EV charging cap and the category of Northgate Fuel Center purchases are those of the card product the account holds.

## Terms

**1. When rewards are computed.** Rewards are computed at each statement close on the statement's net qualifying purchases in each earning category. The earning categories are gas and EV charging, restaurants, travel, Northgate purchases (in clubs and online) and all other purchases. Each statement yields one reward amount per earning category, dated with the statement closing date and belonging to the reward year of that statement.

**2. Rates.** The card's gas and EV charging rate applies on gas and EV charging until the gas and EV charging spend already counted in the reward year reaches the card's gas and EV charging cap, and the card's beyond-cap rate applies beyond it. The card's restaurant rate applies on restaurants, its travel rate on travel, its Northgate purchase rate on Northgate purchases, and its all-other rate on all else.

**3. Gas and EV charging spend already counted.** For the statement being computed, the spend already counted is the qualifying spend of the gas and EV charging rewards earned on the statements of the current reward year before that statement, less the qualifying spend of the gas and EV charging reward reversals on those statements. The room left under the cap is the cap less the spend already counted, and never less than zero. Of the statement's gas and EV charging spend, the part up to the room left earns the gas and EV charging rate and any remainder earns the beyond-cap rate; the two parts are added together and that sum is rounded once.

**4. Northgate Fuel Center.** Northgate Fuel Center purchases earn in the earning category the card product assigns to them.

**5. Cards usable only at Northgate.** A card usable only at Northgate earns only on Northgate purchases.

**6. Transactions that earn only where the card's terms allow.** Membership fees charged to the card earn only where the card's terms provide that membership fees earn, and Northgate Shop Card purchases earn where the card's terms provide that they earn. Cash advances and balance transfers never earn while the card's terms provide that they do not.

**7. Rounding and reward year.** Each category's reward is rounded by the card's rounding convention for earned rewards, and the reward year runs on the card's reward-year basis.

## Gas and EV charging on one statement, worked through

The figures below are hypothetical and chosen only for the arithmetic; they are not the rates or cap of any Northgate card. Hypothetical card: gas and EV charging rate 6%, cap $1000.00, beyond-cap rate 2%. The statement being computed has $250.55 of net gas and EV charging purchases.

| Spend already counted before this statement | Room left under the cap | At 6% | At 2% | Sum before rounding | Reward |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $0.00 | $1000.00 | $250.55 gives $15.033 | nothing | $15.033 | $15.03 |
| $900.00 ($950.00 earned, less $50.00 reversed) | $100.00 | $100.00 gives $6.00 | $150.55 gives $3.011 | $9.011 | $9.01 |
| $1000.00 (exactly the cap) | $0.00 | nothing | $250.55 gives $5.011 | $5.011 | $5.01 |
| $1200.00 | $0.00 (never below zero) | nothing | $250.55 gives $5.011 | $5.011 | $5.01 |

## Another category on the same statement (hypothetical)

Hypothetical restaurant rate 2.5%, net restaurant purchases $41.37: $41.37 at 2.5% gives $1.03425, and the restaurant reward on the statement is $1.03. It is computed and rounded on its own, apart from the gas and EV charging amount.

## Questions answered from the terms

**On which purchases does a card usable only at Northgate earn?** Only on Northgate purchases (term 5).

**Does a gas and EV charging purchase that brings the year's counted spend past the cap earn one rate throughout?** No. The part up to the room left earns the gas and EV charging rate and the remainder earns the beyond-cap rate (term 3).

**Do gas and EV charging reversals of earlier statements change the room left?** Yes. Their qualifying spend is deducted from the spend already counted (term 3).
